title: Race my Nyborg share pack
author: Blitzwing /nyborg
body: The finish card now invites with exactly Race my Nyborg and a copyable watch link that encodes looks, names and builds, so a guest with no library still sees the sharer's lineup.
Start CTA hardening: el() never dumps a function as button text, and play assets are cache-busted so Pages cannot mix stale modules after the mobile pass.
next: Splash default seed on nyborgs; freeze the friend-playtest field-note template.
